# HAZWOPER OSHA Training — ELDT Partner Program

> HAZWOPER OSHA Training is listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry and delivers accredited, bilingual (English/Spanish) FMCSA ELDT theory training online. Through the ELDT Partner Program, businesses, school districts, and government agencies can get a dedicated, branded landing page selling that same ELDT theory training, without building or hosting a training platform themselves.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/): Overview of the ELDT Partner Program.
- [ELDT Partner Program](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/partner-program.html): Full program details — no setup cost, 50/50 revenue split, full ELDT theory course library, FAQ.
- [School Districts](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/school-districts.html): In-house ELDT theory training for school bus drivers (Class B CDL + School Bus (S) Endorsement). Bulk per-seat pricing tiers, SCORM packages, and a dedicated landing page contingent on exclusivity as the district's ELDT theory training provider.
- [Government Agencies](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/government-agencies.html): In-house ELDT theory training for government fleets, covering the full FMCSA ELDT theory course library (Class A, Class B, and every major endorsement). Bulk per-seat pricing tiers, SCORM packages, and a dedicated landing page contingent on exclusivity as the agency's ELDT theory training provider.
- [Apply](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/apply.html): Application to become an ELDT Training Partner.
- [About](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/about.html): Company background, mission, leadership, and accreditation.
- [Contact](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/contact.html): Contact information and inquiry form.

## ELDT guides

- [All guides](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/): Index of ELDT guides for employers, CDL schools, staffing agencies, school districts, government agencies, and partners.
- [What Is ELDT? FMCSA Entry-Level Driver Training Requirements Explained](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/what-is-eldt.html): A plain-English guide to the FMCSA Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT) rule: who needs it, what theory and behind-the-wheel training cover, the Training Provider Registry, and common exemptions.
- [How to Become an ELDT Theory Training Provider (and a Faster Alternative)](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/how-to-become-eldt-theory-training-provider.html): What it takes to register as an FMCSA ELDT theory training provider: curriculum, instructors, assessments, TPR registration, and recordkeeping, plus how to offer ELDT theory without building your own program.
- [ELDT Requirements for School Bus Drivers: A Guide for School Districts](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-requirements-school-bus-drivers.html): What FMCSA ELDT means for school districts hiring bus drivers: Class B, Passenger, and School Bus endorsement training, theory vs. behind-the-wheel, in-house options, and how to cut per-driver costs.
- [ELDT for Government Fleets: A Guide for Cities, Counties, and State Agencies](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-for-government-fleets.html): How federal, state, and local government agencies can meet FMCSA ELDT requirements for public works, transit, utility, and fleet drivers, including in-house training, exemptions, and procurement tips.
- [ELDT Theory vs. Behind-the-Wheel Training: What's the Difference?](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-theory-vs-behind-the-wheel.html): Compare the two parts of FMCSA Entry-Level Driver Training: what theory and behind-the-wheel cover, who can deliver each, how they're assessed, and why many programs split them between providers.
- [The FMCSA Training Provider Registry: How It Works and How to Verify a Provider](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/fmcsa-training-provider-registry-guide.html): How the FMCSA Training Provider Registry works, what providers must certify, how completion records reach the state, and how employers and drivers can verify an ELDT provider before buying training.
- [ELDT for Trucking Companies: Onboarding New CDL Drivers Faster](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-for-trucking-companies.html): How motor carriers and private fleets can use ELDT theory training to recruit, upskill, and onboard new CDL drivers faster, including company-sponsored training, B-to-A upgrades, and endorsement add-ons.
- [ELDT for Staffing Agencies: Build a CDL Driver Pipeline and New Revenue](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-for-staffing-agencies.html): How driver staffing agencies, workforce development boards, and reentry programs can use ELDT theory training to build CDL candidate pipelines and add a new revenue stream.
- [How CDL Schools Can Outsource ELDT Theory and Focus on Behind-the-Wheel](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-schools-outsource-eldt-theory.html): Why CDL and truck driving schools are moving ELDT theory online with a registered partner: lower instructor costs, faster student starts, Spanish-language access, and a share of theory revenue.
- [Hazmat Endorsement ELDT Requirements: What Drivers and Employers Need to Know](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/hazmat-endorsement-eldt-requirements.html): ELDT requirements for the Hazardous Materials (H) and Hazmat & Tank Vehicle (X) endorsements: theory-only training, curriculum topics, TSA security threat assessment, and how employers can speed up the process.
- [Spanish-Language ELDT Training: Options for Bilingual Drivers and Employers](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/spanish-eldt-training.html): Can ELDT theory be taken in Spanish? What employers, schools, and agencies should know about bilingual ELDT courses, English language proficiency rules, and reaching Spanish-speaking CDL candidates.
- [Adding ELDT Training to Your Business: A Revenue Guide for Associations, Consultants, and Industry Suppliers](https://tpp.eldttraining.us/guides/add-eldt-training-revenue-associations-consultants.html): How trucking associations, safety consultants, insurance agencies, equipment dealers, and industry suppliers can add ELDT theory training to their offerings with no setup cost and a 50/50 revenue split.

## Key facts

- Accredited provider: HAZWOPER OSHA Training is listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry for ELDT theory training.
- Courses: FMCSA ELDT theory only (not behind-the-wheel training or skills testing) — Class A, Class B, Class B-to-A upgrade, HAZMAT (H), Hazmat & Tank Vehicle (X), Tanker (N), Passenger (P), and School Bus (S) endorsements. Every course includes an English/Spanish toggle.
- ELDT Partner Program: no setup cost; HAZWOPER OSHA Training remains the seller of record, handling checkout, certificates, recordkeeping, and support; revenue is split 50/50 with the partner.
- School Districts / Government Agencies pricing: per-seat, volume-tiered (lower rate at higher seat counts); hosted seats or a SCORM package for the buyer's own LMS; a dedicated landing page and locked-in bulk pricing require the district/agency to remain an exclusive ELDT theory training customer of HAZWOPER OSHA Training.
- Contact: sales@hazwoper-osha.com, +1-866-429-6742.
